system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.
human:
Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Build a verifiable soft robotic system named ShapeLockGraspE. The resulting scenario must make the following behavior testable: Conform around a fragile object and regulate total normal grasp force without local overload. Represent the plant without omitting its structure. A six-section continuum arm combines three tendons with thermally activated stiffness elements whose bending stiffness changes between 320 K and 345 K. Tendon tension and section heater power are independently controlled, with command magnitude bounded by 50.6 N-or-18-W. Use actuator sensing, distributed contact sensing, and object pose measurement. Enable compliant collision with friction coefficient 0.70 on a rigid support surface. Apply pressure or tendon control with contact-force redistribution and a controlled 4.8 N tangential load middle-third disturbance. Run at 250 Hz for 16 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Acceptance is fail-closed. Require actuator and deformation bounds, per-contact and total force bands, object displacement, and no contact loss, primary tracking error below 0.013 m after 10.4 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
